title: Searching for Autoregressive Neural Architectures from Fundamental Operations
abstract: arXiv:2611.21111v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Expressive Neural Architecture Search (NAS) search spaces are desirable as they do not restrict the space of potential architectures to what is already established. However, few search spaces are expressive enough to represent a broad range of architecture families, and those that are have focused primarily on image classification problems. The task of autoregressive sequence modelling has become ubiquitous in modern machine learning, but no existing search space supports the construction of and search over sequence models from fundamental operations, instead imposing strong inductive biases on the structure of potential architectures. This work describes how the expressive einspace search space can be extended to yield a search space capable of representing autoregressive models using fundamental operations. We perform a series of experiments showing that the novel einspaceAR search space can find capable autoregressive sequence model

translated_title: 从基础操作中搜索自回归神经架构
translated_abstract: 富有表现力的神经架构搜索（NAS）搜索空间是非常理想的，因为它们不会将潜在架构的空间限制在已有架构的范围之内。然而，很少有搜索空间具有足够的表现力来表示广泛的架构家族，且那些具有表现力的搜索空间主要集中于图像分类问题。自回归序列建模任务在现代机器学习中已无处不在，但目前没有任何现有搜索空间支持从基础操作出发构建序列模型并对其进行搜索，而是对潜在架构的结构施加了强烈的归纳偏置。本工作描述了如何扩展富有表现力的einspace搜索空间，从而产生一个能够使用基础操作表示自回归模型的搜索空间。我们进行了一系列实验，表明新颖的einspaceAR搜索空间可以找到性能强大的自回归序列模型。
tldr: 本文扩展了富有表现力的einspace搜索空间，提出首个能够从基础操作构建并搜索自回归序列模型的新颖搜索空间einspaceAR，突破了以往搜索空间仅适用于图像分类且对架构结构施加强归纳偏置的限制。
en_tdlr: This work extends the expressive einspace search space to create einspaceAR, a novel search space capable of representing and searching over autoregressive sequence models built from fundamental operations, overcoming the limitations of prior search spaces that focus on image classification and impose strong inductive biases.
